modes.stored: stored term order, every product and partial sum rounded to FP32 (the production executor)
modes.balanced: pairwise sums over bias and products, like a parallel prefix network
modes.fused: each product added without rounding it first (fused multiply-add), stored order
modes.balancedFused: pairwise sums whose first level fuses one product into each pair
modes.float64: every value in float64, boolean atom as score >= 0.5, no rounding anywhere
modes.roundingStrict: stored order at rounding points, balanced and fused everywhere else
modes.float64RoundingStrict: stored FP32 order at rounding points (inputs rounded to FP32), float64 everywhere else
